sections.title: Default costs by location overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Default costs by location are used to declare the amount of each cost type per location and effective date.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Default costs by location

![](/uploads/688e2b0411d688c573f62d44.png)

The list shows the default costs already declared per location.

![](/uploads/c41f293630285b523903182d.png)

sections.title: Creating a cost by location
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/1252e552e9e2c49538e88590.png)

### Step 2

Enter the cost information.

![](/uploads/843ca32655dfa2225d4890ef.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Effective date | Date the cost starts applying. |
| Location | Location it applies to. |
| Cost type | Type of cost to configure. |
| Amount | Default amount. |
| Description | Additional notes. |
| Company | Company it applies to. |

![](/uploads/3c20030cf09f3de2326b808b.png)

### Step 3

Click **Save manually** to finish.

![](/uploads/be708e1aac8256ac8545ad3a.png)
